The differences are:

19 − 2 = 17  
38 − 19 = 19  
74 − 38 = 36  
129 − 74 = 55  

These differences follow the rule: each is the sum of the previous two:

17 + 19 = 36  
19 + 36 = 55  
36 + 55 = 91  

So the next term is:

129 + 91 = 220

<answer>220</answer>
